title: Little Erhei Gets Married
synopsis: The story of Little Erhei’s marriage, adapted from Zhao Shuli’s famous short story.

fullText.simplified:
高老汉的神课

    大家看到是大南小南抓人，都不敢说话。小二黑和多喜就这么被带走了。
    高老汉回家后，一直在说：“我就知道这几天会出事！我就知道这几天会出事！前几天我算过了，算命书上说，这几天会有大事！你看，真的就出事了。”说着，他又拿出算命书，又算了算。算完后，他站起来走来走去，一直在说：“不好了，不好了！要出大事了！”
    家里大家都没睡。小二黑的妈妈哭着说：“现在怎么办呀！”
    小二黑的大哥大黑看到爸妈都不知道该怎么办，就说：“爸、妈，别怕！我们二黑和多喜约会，没做错什么事，我想他们不会把二黑怎么样的。这样吧，我先到区里打听打听，你们先睡吧！”说完，拿着包出去了。
fullText.traditional:
高老漢的神課

    大家看到是大南小南抓人，都不敢說話。小二黑和多喜就這麼被帶走了。
    高老漢回家後，一直在說：“我就知道這幾天會出事！我就知道這幾天會出事！前幾天我算過了，算命書上說，這幾天會有大事！你看，真的就出事了。”說著，他又拿出算命書，又算了算。算完後，他站起來走來走去，一直在說：“不好了，不好了！要出大事了！”
    家裡大家都沒睡。小二黑的媽媽哭著說：“現在怎麼辦呀！”
    小二黑的大哥大黑看到爸媽都不知道該怎麼辦，就說：“爸、媽，別怕！我們二黑和多喜約會，沒做錯什麼事，我想他們不會把二黑怎麼樣的。這樣吧，我先到區裡打聽打聽，你們先睡吧！”說完，拿著包出去了。

raw.synopsis: The story of Little Erhei’s marriage, adapted from Zhao Shuli’s famous short story.
sentence_translations: Everyone saw that it was Big Nan and Little Nan arresting people, and did not dare to say anything.
Little Erhei and Duoxi were taken away like this.
After Gao Laohan returned home, he kept on saying, ..
.. “I knew something bad would happen during these few days! I knew something bad would happen during these few days!
I read the fortunes a few days ago. The fortune-telling book said that these few days something really bad will happen!
You see, something bad really did happen.”
As he said this, he again took out the fortune-telling book, and read the fortunes again.
After finishing reading the fortunes, he stood up and paced back and forth, all the while saying, ..
.. “We’re done for, we’re done for! Something really bad is going to happen!”
At home, everyone was still awake. Littler Erhei’s mother said in tears, “What do we do now?”
Little Erhei’s eldest brother Big Hei saw his parents didn’t know what to do, and said, “Dad, Mom, don’t be afraid!”
Our Erhei didn’t do anything wrong by going on a date with Duoxi. I don’t think they’ll do anything to Erhei.
How about this: I will go to the district now to make some inquiries. You both get some sleep first!”
After he said this, he took his bags and went out.
